Japan's SBI, SMBC Group, and Solana Foundation Partner as SBI Solana Global Launches On-Chain Finance Operations SBI Holdings, a major Japanese internet-based financial group, Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group (SMBC Group), Japan's second-largest banking group, and the Solana Foundation announced the completion of agreements for a new joint venture structure. SBI R3 Japan has been renamed SBI Solana Global and commenced full-scale operations. The company will focus on four areas: stablecoin payments and cross-border remittances, financial asset tokenization, real-world asset tokenization, and on-chain asset management using stablecoins and tokenized assets. It plans to establish operations in Japan before expanding across Asia and globally. — link
